svg.title: 2015 TNUSRB SI question 109, L-shaped number pattern
svg.desc: Faithful redrawing from a secondary question paper scan. Each of three figures has three squares in an L. First: top 1, lower left 1, lower right 1. Second: top 3, lower left 27, lower right 9. Third: top 5, lower left question mark, lower right 25.
svg.text: Diagram transcribed from coaching archive page 12; original TNUSRB scan not certified
